ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x < 5
   C. x > 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

2. Solve for x: x + 7 = 18. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 12
   C. 7
   D. 11

3. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 14
   C. 50
   D. 49

4. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 42
   C. 12
   D. 36

5. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.7
   C. 37
   D. 31.6

6. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

7. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 57
   C. 56
   D. 15

8. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x

9. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 36
   C. 90
   D. 18

10. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. Cannot tell
   D. They are equal

11. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.7
   C. 15
   D. 15.6

12. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 24

13. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 22
   D. 77

14. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 23
   C. 19
   D. 7

15. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 11
   C. 22
   D. 121

16. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 6

17. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

18. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 25
   C. 19
   D. 19.7

19. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 9
   C. 18
   D. 81

20. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

21. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 20
   C. 21
   D. 9

22. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 32
   C. 33
   D. 4

23. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

24. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 5

25. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23.7
   C. 23
   D. 23.6

26. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 73
   C. 1
   D. 72

27. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 2

28. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 22
   C. 30
   D. 105

29. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 31

30. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 4
   C. 32
   D. 33
